A.label: A · Baseline (zero-shot)
A.description: Unmodified Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with the shared system prompt.

A_fewshot.label: A+ · Baseline (few-shot prompt)
A_fewshot.description: Same weights as A; the system prompt adds two worked examples (prompting, no weight change).

B.label: B · Teacher-distilled LoRA
B.description: LoRA on execution-verified demonstrations generated by the Qwen3.5-4B teacher.

C.label: C · Independent (oracle) LoRA
C.description: LoRA on trajectories from an independent programmatic oracle, executed and validated.

D.label: D · Combined LoRA (mixed)
D.description: LoRA on the union of B and C data, shuffled together (same step budget).

Dseq.label: D' · Combined LoRA (sequential B→C)
Dseq.description: LoRA trained on B data for half the steps, then C data for the other half.

teacher.label: Teacher · Qwen3.5-4B (4-bit)
teacher.description: Qwen3.5-4B (MLX 4-bit) — reference only; it produced the B data.

oracle.label: Oracle (programmatic upper bound)
oracle.description: Programmatic policy reading the gold task graph — the validator's ceiling, not a model.

splits.eval_ood: templates never seen in training (novel phrasing / task graphs / depth 4-5)
splits.eval_unseen: tool domains never seen in training (inventory, maps)
splits.eval_renamed: training templates with every tool/parameter renamed (held-out alias vocabulary)
